referenceDna.annotatedDescription: The official Edmonton specialty practice site opens with an atmospheric, low-light clinic image, compact consultation navigation, and a large statement with restrained handwritten-style display. A light context strip follows. The long page moves between clean editorial text panels, specialist portraits, a treatment selector, an advanced-technology explanation, a patient-review chapter, and detailed patient case stories. A consultation section and questions precede a deep dark contact/footer. The palette alternates near-black photo fields, white editorial areas, and muted lilac; the desktop story uses broad alternating image/text panels while mobile becomes a long stack. The practice identity, clinical claims, staff, patient imagery, case results, reviews, metrics, and exact trade dress remain source-only.

mobileRecomposition.strategy: sequential specialty-story panels with direct consultation action
rules: use a subject-safe hero crop and maintain text contrast
stack portraits and explanations with comfortable reading measure
show one treatment item at a time with labeled controls
replace case-image strips with fully readable vertical story panels
keep FAQs and contact in the normal flow without overlays

prohibitedPatterns: reusing source brand, logo, typeface, photos, staff, patient cases, before/after media, reviews, metrics, or claims
invented specialist credentials, treatment results, warranties, success rates, pricing, timelines, or financing claims
case photography without client approval and patient consent
unsupported high-volume counters or decorative statistic tiles
tiny low-contrast clinical text or motion that hides patient information
a wall of repeated generic service cards

requiredSignatureElements.description: image-led specialty opening that establishes a distinct practice mood and one direct next step
compact, navigable selector that distinguishes major treatment categories
alternating image and explanation chapters, with a process alternative when client-approved case evidence is unavailable

acceptanceChecks: The opening explains the verified specialty and provides a clear consultation action.
Treatment categories are distinct and lead to useful patient-facing scope information.
Technology, qualifications, patient reviews, and case imagery appear only when verified and approved by the client.
At 390 px, specialist stories and controls stack without overflow or clipped faces.
No source identity, photo, patient case, statistic, review, or unsupported treatment claim is reused.

review.notes: Isolated review candidate only. Alberta Dental Association listing corroborates the clinic identity, Edmonton address, and prosthodontics specialty. Full-page desktop and mobile captures were inspected after lazy media and offscreen sections were rendered; no broken images, page errors, or width overflow were observed. Not added to the core or registry. Requester-attested clearance is not represented as an independently verified source-owner grant.
